messages:
Maya (CS Ops): Heads-up: playbooks are missing telemetry-linked events. external_id from mobile SDK isn't in Account.external_ids so triggers miss matches. Can we backfill and add an on-write hook?

Evan: Agreed. Which cohorts?

Maya (CS Ops): trial->paid, onboarding-active, and enterprise-eval. Backfill cutoff last_seen > 2025-06-01. Keep ancient rows out.

Sam: I'll run a staged backfill. Plan: snapshot, populate a tmp_external_ids column, run diffs, then swap. Example quick SQL: 
```
UPDATE accounts a
SET tmp_external_ids = array_distinct(coalesce(a.tmp_external_ids, '{}') || t.telem_id)
FROM telemetry_ids t
WHERE t.account_id = a.id AND t.last_seen > '2025-06-01';
```
After verifying counts we can swap.

Evan: Matcher change needed too: prefer external_ids over primary_email when matching incoming events, to avoid shared-email duplicates. I can add a config flag.

Maya (CS Ops): Webhook payload we need for playbooks: account_id, external_ids, event_type, event_ts, optional source="telemetry". Debounce please 10m window to avoid mobile SDK retries creating dupes.

Sam: Lambda will dedupe by (account_id,event_type) with a 10m TTL and rate-limit staging to 500/min during backfill.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Sam for 2026-03-03 03:00 UTC. :gear: 

Maya (CS Ops): I'll own verification: post pre/post counts and 10 sample rows. Also please add a weekly dashboard card: "Accounts with telemetry external_ids".

Evan: Got it. Once staging is green we'll run prod backfill and flip the matcher.

Sam: Running staging now; will post counts in this thread when done.
